test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'STUMBLE' is coded as '95', and 'NASTY' is coded as '55'. How will 'CLOUDY' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/jMzDwu46fdWw8mOtNCHnXhMPkXxwy-9xQN4znh87EeBFGbh4XLlxe7zwRE67pw4XVWHvSe7pK6BqFS-SVQw-7GlGq-_eFo7-O0HODw1lhkC4aaRv-NzA-4vql_D-5xB6eqF2urhS6sFup9xDlSeWIqzuBU3XeMoFMHBCho6qofQzINckbfCyyI5XghE8] 

Logic: Addition of reverse place value - Number of Vowel = Code

'STUMBLE' is coded as '95

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d948cb9905fbc3289dd654c71a3a9356ef143dd6729ddd75bb491c96cc02ded3.png] 

⇒ U and E are two vowel here

⇒ 8 + 7 + 6 + 14 + 25 + 15 + 22 = 97 - 2 = 95

And,

'NASTY' is coded as '55'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c09e9c42da8208ec627980ccc1a73ef2bae34b1ecd5e593a6ffcf845c9b8bd6.png] 

⇒ A is the only vowel here

⇒ 13 + 26 + 8 + 7 + 2 = 56 - 1 = 55

Similarly,

'CLOUDY' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dae5063e4c9b87076f77f20dd6581d74054163ea8c83c0aabca3078bf402863a.png] 

⇒ O and U two vowel are here

⇒ 24 + 15 + 12 + 6 + 23 + 2 = 82 - 2 = 80

Hence, the correct answer is "80".
